params.948: Speak with Xenia outside the Carnillean mansion in south-west Ardougne.
params.949: At first, you'll want a clear inventory. Towards the end of the quest, some food might be useful.
params.950: You will need to dodge attacks from a powerful creature.
params.951: 1 Quest Point, 2,500 Thieving XP and 2,500 Construction XP, an item worth 5,000 coins, two 1,500 XP lamps, a bag of sweets, Construction supplies, a treasure chest for setting up treasure hunts, and 2 spins on the Squeal of Fortune.
